lede: NC State carries the stronger underlying team rating — +1.8 against -3.5, a 5.3-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Stanford +7.1 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with NC State winning 69% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is receivers, where NC State leads Stanford by 99 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 84% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
